title: Report Writing
description: Outputs reconciliation results in .kaava/runs and in text or JSON.
body: Writing reconciliation results: `.kaava/runs/<node-uuid>/reconcile.json` per marker identifier touched (PRD `SCHEMATIFY-PRD.md` section 9.3), and the consolidated report `kaava reconcile --out` writes or prints, in `text` or `json` form. Section 9.3 names the path `runs/<node-uuid>/reconcile.json` but not its schema; section 6.1's storage layout is what puts the `runs/` tree inside `.kaava/`, alongside `nodes/`.
